scope: Independent fixed C2 pressure,0.1N,2mm radius. Native fields have two pole sources; these are separate from full-source physical-pad histories.
first_difference: Native source-profile reconstruction difference on its unchanged coarse elastic domain; same-RHS core agreement independently verified.
second_difference: Independent prescribed-C2 discretization/geometry difference from coarse to fine domain.
decomposition: Integrate signed tensor differences and their cross term; no subtraction of scalar RMS errors.
